people.name: Damascus
people.line: Ancient city, capital of Syria, important in biblical history.

translations.web: When I couldn’t see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of those who were with me, I came into Damascus.
translations.bsb: Because the brilliance of the light had blinded me, my companions led me by the hand into Damascus.
translations.kjv: And when I could not see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of them that were with me, I came into Damascus.
translations.asv: And when I could not see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of them that were with me I came into Damascus.
